item.text:
**Assessment**
Mixed, leaning positive on tactical regime preservation. In 2024 Jokowi repeatedly used audits, mitigation, diplomacy, coalition brokerage, and a constitutional handover to keep objectives and influence on track, but much of it was reactive and the same year also showed rule-bending, coercive control of dissent, and weak accountability.

**Evidence**
- [Jokowi orders audit of Indonesia's data centres after cyberattack](https://www.scmp.com/news/asia/southeast-asia/article/3268495/jokowi-orders-audit-indonesias-data-centres-after-cyberattack) | Reuters via South China Morning Post | 2024-06-28 - After a major ransomware attack disrupted public services, Jokowi ordered an audit rather than deny the failure or escalate punitively. This is direct crisis management that preserves state capacity. IDs: `8B.9`, `8B.8`
- [President urges BPKP to audit national data center governance](https://en.antaranews.com/news/317175/president-urges-bpkp-to-audit-national-data-center-governance) | ANTARA News | 2024-06-28 - The government publicly acknowledged the cyber failure and shifted into governance audit mode, which is a visible course correction. IDs: `8B.9`, `8B.8`
- [President Jokowi asks for mitigation on alleged NPWP leak](https://www.antaranews.com/berita/4345027/presiden-jokowi-minta-perlunya-mitigasi-soal-kebocoran-data-npwp) | ANTARA News | 2024-09-19 - Jokowi directed Kominfo, Finance, and BSSN to mitigate the breach quickly, showing cross-agency crisis response aimed at limiting damage. IDs: `8B.9`, `8B.8`
- [Jokowi says dialogue is the best way to reduce escalation in the Middle East](https://presidenri.go.id/siaran-pers/presiden-jokowi-tegaskan-dialog-adalah-solusi-terbaik-untuk-konflik-di-timur-timur/) | Presidential Secretariat of the Republic of Indonesia | 2024-10-05 - Jokowi framed the Middle East crisis in de-escalatory, diplomacy-first terms, which helps preserve Indonesia’s external posture and influence. IDs: `8B.9`
- [Indonesia joins countries prohibiting nuclear weapons](https://en.antaranews.com/news/327307/indonesia-joins-countries-prohibiting-nuclear-weapons) | ANTARA News | 2024-09-25 - Indonesia deposited its TPNW ratification instrument, reinforcing a restrained, anti-escalatory international image rather than coercive leverage. IDs: `8B.9`
- [Farewell/welcome ceremony for Jokowi to Prabowo Subianto](https://setkab.go.id/en/farewell-welcome-ceremony-for-indonesias-president-from-jokowi-to-prabowo-subianto/) | Sekretariat Kabinet Republik Indonesia | 2024-10-20 - Jokowi formally transferred power on inauguration day, showing he ultimately accepted the constitutional handover instead of resisting an adverse transition. IDs: `8B.9`, `4B.2`
- [Outgoing Indonesian president gives cabinet jobs to loyalists of successor Prabowo](https://theprint.in/world/outgoing-indonesian-president-gives-cabinet-jobs-to-loyalists-of-successor-prabowo/2228867/) | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-08-19 - Jokowi used late-term appointments to smooth the transition and preserve influence, a classic regime-maintenance move even if it was patronage-heavy. IDs: `8B.9`, `7B.9`
- [Bulk of Indonesia data hit cyber attack not backed up, officials say](https://www.asia-pacific-solidarity.net/news/2024-06-28/bulk-of-indonesia-data-hit-cyber-attack-not-backed-officials-say.html) | Reuters via APSN | 2024-06-28 - The underlying failure exposed weak backup and preparedness, so the correction was reactive rather than evidence of strong anticipatory adaptation. IDs: `8B.9`, `8B.8`
- [Protests across Indonesia as parliament delays change to election law](https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/indonesia-shelves-plan-revise-election-law-protests-rage-2024-08-22/) | Reuters | 2024-08-22 - Allies’ election-rule push was widely seen as helping Jokowi’s son and consolidating family advantage, but protests forced a delay, showing the tactic backfired. IDs: `8B.9`, `4B.2`, `7B.9`
- [Indonesia leader accused of bias, interference in presidential election](https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/indonesia-leader-accused-of-bias-interference-in-presidential-election-2024-02-01/) | Reuters | 2024-02-01 - Visible alignment with Prabowo while his son was on the ticket looked like incumbent power being used to shape succession, not neutral institutional restraint. IDs: `8B.9`, `4B.2`
- [Freedom on the Net 2024: Indonesia](https://freedomhouse.org/country/indonesia/freedom-net/2024) | Freedom House | 2024 - Kominfo’s direct blocking powers, election-period monitoring, and pressure on critics show a coercive information-control posture that preserved state leverage but narrowed opposition space. IDs: `8B.9`, `4B.6`
- [Indonesia racism/discrimination against indigenous Papuans](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/09/18/indonesia-racism-discrimination-against-indigenous-papuans) | Human Rights Watch | 2024-09-18 - HRW documented arbitrary arrests, torture, extrajudicial killings, and displacement in Papua with weak accountability, suggesting coercive control substituted for durable institutional correction. IDs: `8B.9`, `8B.8`
- [Analysis: A decade of Jokowi, Indonesia's democracy icon, leaves illiberal legacy, critics say](https://theprint.in/world/analysis-a-decade-of-jokowi-indonesias-democracy-icon-leaves-illiberal-legacy-critics-say/2310394/) | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-10-14 - Reuters’ end-of-term analysis says patronage, dynastic politics, and weaker institutional integrity defined the decade, the clearest broad negative signal for clean, durable regime management. IDs: `8B.9`, `7B.9`

**Search gap**
Public sources are strong on the visible front end of 2024: cyber incidents, election maneuvering, Papua, foreign policy, and the transition to Prabowo. I did not find a direct internal record of Jokowi’s private crisis playbook or a comprehensive account of how he chose between implementers inside the palace, so this judgment relies on public actions and elite reporting rather than insider documentation.
